attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names both its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the other. The corpus keeps a `gaianos-martyr-11-august` and a `gaianus-5-may`; those are other entries on the same calendar and therefore other commemorations, and nothing on either page joins them to this one. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
